title: Finish Graphql Schema With Complete Store Api
description: Finish the semio/graphql/schema.graphql. Complete all commands from KitCommandKind by adding a dedicated KitCommandInput and ChangeKitInteraction type for each. Keep the existing diff-based design (KitDiff with hash + last pointer, ChangeKitInteraction forward/backward). Use sketchpad index.tsx as a reference for the complete store API (sessions, operations, selections, candidates, conflicts). Add hash and entity links (kit, parent, children, etc.) to every type. Name things semantically. Extend Query, Mutation, and Subscription to expose the full store.
summary: Aligned the semio GraphQL SDL checks with the current semio/rs DTO surface: no Family DTO exposure, no kit-level ports/families, Type-owned ports, Rust coordinate shape, and Kit version/uri/props coverage. Extended the existing engine test runner to validate those schema contracts and to use the local Python venv directly when present. Fixed engine test blockers by adding current pydantic/graphene-pydantic compatibility aliases, using the SQLite folder-kit fallback when semio-store is unavailable, restoring matching reference pieces when restoring missing connections, and correcting an impossible duplicate-key assertion. Verified the engine test suite and Rust crate tests pass.
